title: ID0372930-DC/Si-D/NL[STBpCB] - OCPP offline
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
OCPP offline and ELMS enabling
Root cause:
WAN failover?
Solution:
CFast Card Flashed,
Both Router made online
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: Multiple issues on charger STBpCB
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
Charger STBpCB loses connection to OCPP regularly. Could you verify whether the WAN failover is disabled. There’s only connection through a SIM.
Also, the OCPP back-end (LMS) does not receive any info on the actual Power Delivery. They say the charger does not share this info. Can we enable this?
Thomas

additional_info.subject: ID0372930-DC/Si-D/NL[STBpCB] - OCPP offline CRM:00315001671
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas,
Backend needs to add Energy.Active.Import.Register themselves. If I add it, then after a reboot it's removed.
For the MeterValueSampleInterval I got from one charger like this:
"MeterValueSampleInterval": {
"readonly": false,
"value": 0,
"unit": "seconds"
I hope I answered to your questions. I am still waiting for the SSH access.
Best regards,
Francisco
